description: OpenAI chat-completions checks. Used by the chat and agent profiles (models checks also by responses). Paths are relative to the base URL, which normally ends in /v1.

checks.title: GET /models returns a list of {id} objects
checks.fix_hint: Many clients (IDE plugins, chat UIs, agent CLIs) discover models through GET /v1/models. Return {"object":"list","data":[{"id":"...","object":"model"}]}, behind the same auth as chat.

checks.title: The tested model id is listed by /models
checks.fix_hint: Clients that validate the model against /models will refuse it. List every routable model id exactly as callers must send it (case and prefix included).

checks.title: Non-stream completion has choices[0].message.content

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Return {"choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"..."},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}. If max_tokens is rejected, the endpoint expects max_completion_tokens only (see chat.max_completion_tokens); most clients still send max_tokens, so accept both.

checks.title: Non-stream response reports usage tokens
checks.fix_hint: Cost trackers and rate limiters read usage.prompt_tokens / completion_tokens / total_tokens. If the upstream omits usage, count tokens at the gateway rather than dropping the field.

checks.title: Response has id, object=chat.completion and created
checks.fix_hint: Strict SDKs (typed clients in Go, Rust, Java) fail to decode a response without id/object/created. Fill them even when the upstream does not.

checks.title: Reasoning dialect (informational)
checks.fix_hint: There is no single standard: DeepSeek-style APIs use message.reasoning_content, some routers use message.reasoning or reasoning_details. Do not inline <think> tags in content; clients will show them. Document which field you emit.

checks.title: Stream is SSE: text/event-stream, data: lines, JSON chunks

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Send Content-Type: text/event-stream and one `data: {json}` line per chunk followed by a blank line. Do not buffer the whole answer, do not send raw JSON lines (NDJSON), and flush after every event (turn off proxy buffering, e.g. `X-Accel-Buffering: no` behind nginx).

checks.title: Stream ends with data: [DONE]
checks.fix_hint: OpenAI SDKs and many hand-written clients stop reading only at `data: [DONE]`. Without it they hang until the socket closes or treat the answer as truncated. Always send it last, also after errors mid-stream.

checks.title: A stream chunk carries finish_reason
checks.fix_hint: The last content chunk must set choices[0].finish_reason (stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter). Agents use it to decide whether to continue or run tools.

checks.title: stream_options.include_usage yields a usage chunk

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: With stream_options.include_usage=true, send one extra chunk before [DONE] with "choices": [] and a usage object. Without it, streaming clients cannot show or bill token counts.

checks.title: max_completion_tokens is accepted

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Newer OpenAI SDKs and reasoning-model clients send max_completion_tokens instead of max_tokens. Accept both and map to whatever the upstream understands.

checks.title: response_format {type: json_object} is accepted

messages.content: You reply only with compact JSON.
Return the JSON object {"ok":true} and nothing else.

checks.fix_hint: Pass response_format through to the upstream, or drop it explicitly if unsupported; rejecting the request breaks structured-output libraries.

checks.title: json_object mode returns parseable JSON
checks.fix_hint: Content should be bare JSON: no Markdown code fences, no prose. A reasoning model may spend all 16 test tokens thinking; if so, re-run with a non-reasoning model to confirm.

checks.title: Unknown model gives 4xx with a JSON error message

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Return 400 or 404 with {"error":{"message":"model ... not found","type":"invalid_request_error","code":"model_not_found"}}. A 5xx makes clients retry forever; an HTML page (often from a proxy or CDN) cannot be parsed.

checks.title: Invalid key gives 401/403 with a JSON error message

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Return 401 with {"error":{"message":"invalid api key","type":"authentication_error"}} and never echo the key back. A local server with no auth will show this as a warning; that is expected.
